name: Adversity
description: A paint with an animated pattern that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: Adversity was released on September 24th, 2021, for purchase in a special bundle only available until the 27th of the month.[1]

It could be purchased as part of a larger bundle costing 19,990 ; the bundle was named "Exclusion Zone" and apart from the paint, also came with 250x Ultra Containers, Unlock a protection module slot, and the Night City paint.
The paint was added to ultra containers on October 1st-3rd 2021, during the discount weekend.
The paint was added to containers on January 14th, 2022.
